messages:
maya: Quick sync — token-cost attribution milestone 1 is done (ingest+mapping). Event schema still blocking release because of the `token_type` naming collision with legacy logs. Owners: @alex (ingest), @serena (schema), @david (dashboards). Can owners confirm current blockers and ETA?

alex: I can own the naming convos. My proposal: rename to `token_category` to avoid ambiguity with legacy `token_type`. Minimal migration cost in ingest. :+1:

serena: `token_category` sounds good. Main blocker for schema sign-off is a couple more prod-like event samples so we can validate downstream parsers. @analytics-bot can you run a 24h export for token events? :eyes:

analytics-bot: export job queued: `job_id=exp_2249990000` — estimated completion ~12m. Will post sample file link when ready.

maya: thanks — also quick note on latency: after the batching change we observed a p95 jump (220ms -> 420ms) for token attribution routes. @david did you run the breakdown queries?

david: I did a quick sweep. Query I ran:
```
SELECT route, day, percentile_latency(p95) as p95_ms, percentile_latency(p50) as p50_ms
FROM token_latency
WHERE day >= '2026-03-10'
ORDER BY day DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
Preliminary signal points at increased KV-cache miss rate on the new batcher path. I opened issue #452 with heap/profile. I can share flamegraphs.

alex: noted. I have a tiny PR that updates the schema rename and adjust ingest mapping (#7890). It also adds a short compatibility shim for old `token_type` events. Needs serena review.

serena: reviewing now, ETA ~2h. If approved, i'll draft a migration plan: canary in dev -> staging for 24h, then roll to prod during low-traffic window. Will post checklist (backfill, mapping toggle, dashboard labels).

maya: perfect. Two asks before EOD: (1) owners update the milestone card with blockers/ETA, (2) @david attach the flamegraphs and the sample query results when available. I'll consolidate and present at exec sync tomorrow. :calendar:

analytics-bot: export complete: link: https://artifacts.internal/exp_2249990000/sample_24h_tokens.ndjson (access controlled).
